title: Check If Digits Are Equal in String After Operations I
summary: Given a string s consisting of digits, repeatedly perform the following operation: for each pair of consecutive digits in s , calculate a new digit as the sum of the two digits modulo 10, and replace s with the sequence of these new digits, maintaining their order.
statement: Given a string s consisting of digits, repeatedly perform the following operation: for each pair of consecutive digits in s , calculate a new digit as the sum of the two digits modulo 10, and replace s with the sequence of these new digits, maintaining their order. Return true if the final string consists of two digits that are the same; otherwise, return false.
constraints: Repeatedly replace every adjacent digit pair by its sum modulo ten.
Each round shortens the sequence by one while preserving pair order.
When two digits remain, return whether they are equal.
reference_solution:
def final_two_digits_are_equal(s):
    values=[int(char) for char in s]
    while len(values)>2:values=[(a+b)%10 for a,b in zip(values,values[1:])]
    return values[0]==values[1]
